name: perang-petasan-web
description: Perang Petasan: Fighting PvP 2D side-view - browser multiplayer bertema kampung

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pp/server && npm run build -w @pp/client
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pp/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n client,worker -c magenta,cyan "npm run build -w @pp/client -- --watch" "npm run dev -w @pp/worker"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pp/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pp/client
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:worker && npm run deploy -w @pp/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pp/server && npm run typecheck -w @pp/client && npm run typecheck -w @pp/worker
